description_en: Retrieves the certificate information for a specified accelerated domain name
description_zh: 获取指定加速域名证书信息
name: DescribeVsDomainCertificateInfo

CertDomainName.description_en: The domain name that matches the certificate

CertExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the certificate. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format and is displayed in UTC

CertLife.description_en:
The unit of the certificate's validity period.

months: Month.

years: Year
CertLife.description_zh:
证书时长单位。

months：月。

years：年

CertOrg.description_en: The name of the certificate authority (CA) that issued the certificate

CertType.description_en:
The type of the certificate.

free: A personal test certificate (Free Edition).

cas: An Alibaba Cloud Security certificate.

upload: A custom certificate that you uploaded
CertType.description_zh:
证书类型。

free：个人测试证书（免费版）。

cas：云盾证书。

upload：自定义上传

SSLPub.description_en: The public key of the certificate

ServerCertificateStatus.description_en:
The status of HTTPS.

on: Enabled.

off: Disabled
ServerCertificateStatus.description_zh:
https开启状态。

on：已开启。
off：未开启

Status.description_en:
The status of the certificate.

success: The certificate is valid.

checking: Checking if the domain name is added to Alibaba Cloud CDN.

cname_error: The domain name is not mapped to Alibaba Cloud CDN.

top_domain_cname_error: The top-level domain is not mapped to Alibaba Cloud CDN.

domain_invalid: The domain name contains invalid characters.

unsupport_wildcard: Wildcard domain names are not supported.

applying: The certificate application is in progress.

get_token_timeout: The request for a certificate application token timed out.

check_token_timeout: The token verification timed out.

get_cert_timeout: The request to obtain the certificate timed out.

failed: The certificate application failed
Status.description_zh:
证书状态。
success：已生效。

checking：检测域名是否在阿里云CDN。

cname_error：域名没有切到阿里云CDN。

top_domain_cname_error：顶级域名没有切到阿里云CDN。

domain_invalid：域名包含非法字符。

unsupport_wildcard：不支持泛域名。

applying：证书申请中。

get_token_timeout：证书申请超时。

check_token_timeout：校验超时。
